title: Rocky short-answer problem v1
description: Canonical problem stored in assignments.problems and submission snapshots. Reference answers and grading guidance are private to instructors and trusted grading code.

content.description: Student-visible prompt; Markdown, Unicode, and LaTeX are supported.

reference_answer.description: Private reference answer. Required for new/edited problems; legacy documents may contain an empty string.

grading_guidance.description: Optional private grading criteria and partial-credit guidance; empty string when unset.

authored.description: Use this subschema for new or edited problems. The root schema also supports historical snapshots.
